impact.title: The Impact Is in the Girls
impact.intro: The heart of Girls' Unplugged is not just what we organise. It is what happens when a girl feels less alone, finds her voice, learns something new, makes a friend, or realises she can take the next step.

whereImpactShowsUp.title: Connection
whereImpactShowsUp.description: Girls have opportunities to meet, talk, laugh, and build relationships with other girls.

whereImpactShowsUp.title: Confidence
whereImpactShowsUp.description: A supportive environment can make it easier for girls to speak, ask questions, share ideas, and express themselves.

whereImpactShowsUp.title: Personal Growth
whereImpactShowsUp.description: Conversations and activities create opportunities for reflection, learning, and becoming.

whereImpactShowsUp.title: Joy
whereImpactShowsUp.description: Fun matters too. Games, laughter, and lighter moments are part of creating a community girls actually enjoy being part of.

whereImpactShowsUp.title: Voice
whereImpactShowsUp.description: Girls are encouraged to bring their questions, opinions, experiences, and ideas into the community.

whereImpactShowsUp.title: Belonging
whereImpactShowsUp.description: The Circle is designed to remind girls that they deserve spaces where they can show up as themselves.

communityExperience.description: Finding girls who share experiences, questions, interests, or simply understand can make a community feel like home.
A safe and welcoming environment can make it easier to ask the question that has been sitting in your head.
Sometimes knowing that someone else understands is already a meaningful form of support.
Guest conversations, community discussions, and shared experiences create opportunities to learn from one another.
Friendship and fun are part of the experience, not an afterthought.
Encouragement and connection can help a girl feel more ready to take her next step.

girlLedImpact.title: Impact That Starts With Girls
girlLedImpact.description: Girls' Unplugged is shaped by the girls who are part of it. Their questions, interests, conversations, ideas, feedback, and participation help shape what the community becomes.
principles: Girls can suggest topics and activities.
Girls can share ideas and experiences.
Girls can participate in community activities.
Girls can help make the Circle feel welcoming to others.

programImpact.description: Regular community moments create simple opportunities for Bloomies to stay connected throughout the week.
Conversations with guest speakers give girls opportunities to hear different experiences, learn, and ask questions.
Quarterly calls create dedicated moments for Bloomies to connect beyond everyday group conversations.
Games and lighter activities create room for girls to relax, laugh, and build friendships.
Anonymous submissions can create room for girls to raise questions or share thoughts they may not be ready to attach their names to.

impactApproach.title: How We Think About Impact
impactApproach.description: Impact is not only a big number. We also pay attention to the smaller moments that tell us a girl is connecting, participating, learning, growing, or finding a sense of belonging.
